haan, samajh aaya

Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare pitch ghoomkar wahin lauto. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai. Yahi chakkar ab ek triangle par. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Koi baat nahi, ise doosre, aasaan shabdon mein bolti hoon. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Ab ek khet socho, kone P, Q, R, S, T. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise-jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh jod adhoora. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yahan tak theek hai?

director.text: aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka
Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Ab wapas apne kaam par. Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 15 cm

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Hexagon ki kitni bhujaon par label likha hai?
ek par
Bilkul sahi. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 5 cm
5 cm sahi nahi hai. Ungli ko hexagon ke kinaare par ek poora chakkar ghumao, aur har bhuja par uski lambai jodte jao. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 5 cm

5 cm nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Shahad ke chhatte ka ek khaana dekho: uski chhah bhujayein hoti hain, sab ek jaisi. Yahan ek bhuja par 5 cm likha hai, toh baaki paanch bhi 5 cm ki hain. Parimap ke liye chhahon bhujayein ginni hain, sirf likhi hui nahi. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 centimetre

Sahi jawab, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Dhaaga kahan chalta hai, kinaare par ya andar?
mujhe nahi pata
Dhaaga kinaare par chalta hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Rectangle ka kinaara ek dhaage ki tarah khul gaya hai: 6 cm, 4 cm, 6 cm, 4 cm. Andar ki jagah is line mein nahi aati. 6 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude rectangle ke kinaare par ek baar lapetne mein kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 20 centimetre
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Kadam-kadam karke, agla sawaal milkar hal karein?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Dekhte hain, kitni lambi baad lagegi. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: kitne metre hue?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

Haan, pehle tum try karo. Yeh raha sawaal. Teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: 28 m hai na
Sahi jawab. Dekho, baad ko teeno bhujaon par chalna hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti. Toh poora jawab: kyari ke liye 28 m lambi baad. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
samajh nahi aaya
16 mein pehle 4 jodo toh 20, phir bache 8 jodo toh 28 m; 12 mein se kuch nahi chhoota. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi
16 m mein abhi sirf do bhujayein hain, 7 m aur 9 m. Teesri bhuja 12 m bhi kinaare par hai, use bhi jodna hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
